request.style: English, male solo baritone voice, warm choir backing, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, drums, majestic and hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
He chose us in him before the world began
To be holy and blameless in his hand
Destined for adoption as sons through Christ
Brought to himself by his good will

[Chorus]
In him we have redemption through his blood
The forgiveness of trespasses is good
According to the riches of his grace
Which he lavished on us in all places

[Verse]
Poured out on us in all wisdom and understanding
He has made known the mystery of his planning
A plan for the fullness of time in Christ
To bring all things together in his list

[Chorus]
In him we have redemption through his blood
The forgiveness of trespasses is good
According to the riches of his grace
Which he lavished on us in all places

[Bridge]
All things in heaven and all things on earth
In him the head of the whole earth
One head for all in the fullness of time
His will revealed, his love sublime

[Outro]
In him we have redemption through his blood
The forgiveness of trespasses is good
